metadata.title: PlantSync - Smart plant care technology
metadata.description: Web and mobile platform for assisted monitoring, registration and personalized recommendations for caring for your plants.

hero.title: Your plants always well cared for,
hero.subtitle: Monitor their status, receive notifications and access personalized guides without being an expert. PlantSync combines IoT and artificial intelligence to create your digital greenhouse.

benefits.title: More than caring for plants,

register.title: Register your plant

guide.title: Receive smart guidance

iot.title: Your connected
iot.subtitle: Sensors and actuators working together to keep your plants in optimal conditions, 24/7.

humidity.title: Soil moisture
humidity.description: Capacitive sensors that precisely measure the water level available to the roots.

temperature.title: Ambient temperature
temperature.description: Constant monitoring to detect changes that may affect your plants.

light.title: Light intensity
light.description: Measures received lux and adjusts artificial lighting if necessary.

actuators.title: Automatic actuators
actuators.description: Water pump and lamps remotely controllable from the app.

ai.title: Your personal
ai.subtitle: A plant expert available 24/7 that learns from your data to give you increasingly accurate advice.

chat.title: Smart chat
chat.description: Ask anything you need about caring for your plants in natural language.

recommendations.title: Personalized recommendations
recommendations.description: Combined analysis of IoT telemetry, local weather and characteristics of each species.

diagnosis.title: Visual diagnosis
diagnosis.description: Upload a photo and receive an analysis of your plant's health status.

learning.title: Continuous learning
learning.description: The system improves its recommendations based on each plant's history.

chatExample.user: My monstera has yellow leaves, what could it be?
chatExample.assistant: Yellow leaves on Monstera may indicate overwatering. Reviewing your soil moisture data, I see it's constantly at 85%. I recommend reducing watering frequency and ensuring good drainage.

items.question: Do I need IoT sensors to use PlantSync?
items.answer: No, sensors are optional. You can use PlantSync with manual monitoring and still receive reminders and recommendations. Sensors enhance the experience with real-time data.

items.question: What sensors are compatible?
items.answer: PlantSync is compatible with a wide range of humidity, temperature and light sensors. We offer an official kit and also support third-party devices using standard protocols.

items.question: Does the AI work offline?
items.answer: The AI assistant requires internet connection to process queries. However, basic reminders and alerts work offline and sync when you regain connection.

items.question: Can I change plans at any time?
items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade whenever you want. Changes apply to the next billing cycle and you keep access to your historical data.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use end-to-end encryption and comply with privacy regulations. Your data is never shared with third parties without your consent.

items.question: Is there a mobile app?
items.answer: Yes, PlantSync is available as a progressive web app and also as a native application for iOS and Android, synchronized in real time.
